lessons: Freeze whether a historical artifact is a static adoption precheck, an actual class-loading failure or a separate prototype positive. Do not merge these evidence levels.
Class-file scanning, new runtime-loader creation and resource-name discovery are separate paths. An existing class body reloading does not by itself prove a new dependency type is discoverable.
Use an app-root positive control alongside the dependency-output case before proposing broad cache clearing or unsupported-framework claims.
A zero process exit for an observational witness can classify a real negative branch; label it explicitly and do not call it a repair pass.
